blocks.text: MATAKING, Malaysia—The palm-sized green turtle hatchling flailing through the sand on a Malaysian island may seem vulnerable, but its species has emerged as a symbol of hope for wildlife conservation. Green turtles have made the rare jump from endangered to “least concern” in global conservation rankings, a remarkable success when many species are declining. Conservation
